title: Europa League 2025/26 league phase top ten
brief: Name the clubs that finished 1st to 10th in the 2025/26 Europa League league phase table (the top eight went straight to the round of 16).
period: UEFA Europa League 2025/26 league phase, 24 September 2025 to 29 January 2026

notes.Stuttgart: Stuttgart were 11th on 15 points, behind Bologna on goal difference.
notes.Ferencvaros: Ferencvaros were 12th on 15 points, just outside.

checks: UEFA.com's standings and Wikipedia's league phase table agree on the order and on every club's record (Lyon 7-0-1, 18-5; Aston Villa 7-0-1, 14-6; Midtjylland 6-1-1; Real Betis, Porto, Braga and Freiburg all 5-2-1 on 17; Roma and Genk 5-1-2 on 16; Bologna 4-3-1 on 15). Midtjylland, Braga and Genk are not on the game's club list, so they use their common English names.
